context.description: A machine error is a defect, never a frozen run

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of packages/opencode/test/task/verify-spec-RM28.spec.ts (5 tests, re-run: 5 pass, 0 fail, 123 expect calls). Given: the generated config of the loaded release-notes plan (TaskMachine.config) copied with mapStates so that a building state, which only task.started enters, has an eventless row guarded by stateIn('#nowhere/at_all'), built with the port's createMachine and the machine's own ACTIONS/GUARDS (the generator would refuse it). Test 1 proves reachability only after task.started: the copy's first snapshot equals the generated one and every observed fact before T1.4's task.started folds to the same value and log, status active. When/Then dies: test 2 applies task.started T1.1 on the copy broken at T1_1/building; the port's transition fails; engine.applyTo throws an error containing "Child state node '#nowhere/at_all' does not exist on machine 'run'"; in an Effect the exit is a die, not a typed fail; the same after run.started. applyTo is the code of apply (index.ts: apply = applyTo(TaskMachine.machine(plan), ...)), and apply cannot take an unchecked machine, so applyTo is the honest seam. And never returns error: test 3 steps every observed fact, compares each step with the port's transition, requires every returned snapshot to be non-error and equal to the port's, and ends 'died on task.started T1.4'; on an error snapshot from the first macrostep apply dies for run.started, task.started and run.cancelled, naming the error; the real machine folds to active. And the scan: test 4 has check and fromConfig throw 'a guard names the unknown state id <id>' for six copies (always row, unknown state of a known unit, dotted id, inside and(), inside not() in or() of the outcome region, an obligation's event rows); test 5 shows every stateIn id of 7 real plans names a node and check passes. Observation, not a gap: the output-error branch of applyTo is not reached, because this port fails instead of returning an error snapshot after the first macrostep. No gap.
